selectionBasis: 61 inventory rows remain unwritten against 519 posts on disk and 905 live. Selected on MEASURED winnability from wave 1, not the inventory's expected_clicks: every A/B row (explainer, how-to, grammar, translation) passed Gate 4 on a real in-market SERP, while the D-listicle shape (frases/mensagem/Spruche/sozleri/cytaty/quotes) is the one that ABORTED in Brazil at 1-weak-in-8 and measured ten established magazines on de-de. Image-gallery and product-landing rows are excluded on Gate 2 page-type mismatch: a blog cannot rank in a SERP of tools or image packs.

rows.keyword: i miss you in morse code
rows.note: ENGLISH page. The only row this wave with no translation problem. ITU-R M.1677-1 is the actual standard for Morse — cite it, not a blog's table. Verify each letter against the standard and check whether the prosign/spacing convention people use in messages matches it. The written sibling miss-you-number-code-meaning (live) owns numeric codes; READ IT, state the split, cross-link. Real question underneath: a code nobody can read is a puzzle, not a message — say when that is charming and when it fails.

Letter-writing, not phrase-listing — that is the split from all four Spanish siblings. The first-party data is unusually apt here and is the one place it genuinely differentiates: median miss-you letter 88 words, longest 1,024, n=214. Use it. Structure, opening, closing, what not to put in — a sibling in an earlier wave found lovetale.app DOES publish an explicit 'avoid this' list, so do not claim nobody does.

rows.keyword: otra forma de decir te extraño
rows.note: ALTERNATIVES lane, matching the fr/it/tr 'say it differently' rows that all worked. TIGHT PAIR with the written como-decir-te-extrano-sin-decirlo, which owns INDIRECTION (saying it without saying it). Yours is saying it directly in other words. Read it in full, state the split in one sentence, cross-link, and ABORT if you cannot write that sentence honestly. The Italian and French siblings both concluded that a phrase chosen to be 'different' is by definition less idiomatic — test that for Spanish rather than assuming it.

rows.keyword: te echo de menos en català
rows.note: Spanish to Catalan — a distinct LANGUAGE axis, so not a duplicate of any Spanish sibling. Verify every Catalan form against a named authority: DIEC2 (Institut d'Estudis Catalans, dlc.iec.cat), Optimot (Generalitat), or Termcat. Expect 'et trobo a faltar' and check whether 'et enyoro'/'enyorar' is standard, regional or literary — the enyorança/anyoranza link to Portuguese saudade is a real, checkable etymological thread. Valencian vs Central Catalan differences must be named if they exist.

HIGH DUPLICATE RISK — read blogs/tu-me-manques-en-anglais.json FIRST and in full. It already establishes manquer a quelqu'un, the missed person as SUJET, the experiencer as complement d'objet indirect, and the reader-checkable 'lui not le/la' proof, and it says dictionaries disagree on the label (Larousse 'transitif indirect' vs Academie 'intransitif'). If your SERP wants that same explanation, ABORT and say so — a twin is worse than a missing post. A genuine lane exists only if the grammar query wants something the translation row does not give: the historical why (manquer from Italian mancare), the full paradigm across persons, or the je te manque / tu me manques reversal drilled properly. Use COI, never 'dative'.

Polish alternatives lane. Sibling tesknie-za-toba-po-angielsku is on disk: it established za + instrumental via Poradnia PWN ruling 1561, that za/do is SEMANTIC not regional (do can replace za, never the reverse), and real NKJP counts (tesknie za tobie 30 vs tesknie do ciebie 8). PWN is 403 from every route — recover rulings via the Wayback Machine. NKJP works only through PELCRA NKJPSpanSearch with the form's own defaults sent verbatim. Candidates to verify: brakuje mi ciebie, tesknota, myslami jestem przy tobie.

Native Cyrillic keyword; the inventory romanised it for CSV safety. Sibling skuchayu-po-tebe-ili-za-toboy-kak-pravilno owns the CASE dispute (po+dative standard, za+instrumental non-standard per Gramota, and the sharp point that ty has one form tebe for both dative and prepositional so the dispute is invisible in this phrase). Yours is the ENGLISH rendering. State the split, cross-link. Ask what English loses: Russian marks aspect and person on the verb; English 'I miss you' hides it. NKRJa is reachable only through the real browser (SmartCaptcha blocks scripts).

Indonesian to Mandarin. THREE siblings on disk own Indonesian: kangen-kamu-bahasa-inggris (KBBI marks kangen 'cak' colloquial, rindu unlabelled), kangen-kamu-bahasa-jawa (ngoko/krama/krama inggil), cara-bilang-kangen-tanpa-bilang-kangen (only 'dong' softens; 'nih'/'deh' are emphatic). The Chinese sibling wo-xiang-ni-meaning-in-english established that 我想你 is 'miss' ONLY when it is the whole clause (0 exceptions in 31 inspected sentences) and that 想念/思念 are the dedicated words. Your lane is the ID->ZH mapping: which Mandarin form an Indonesian should send, and whether rindu/kangen's register split survives into Chinese. KBBI official site refuses both routes — use kbbi.web.id / kbbi.co.id, both cap-exempt.

rows.keyword: ik mis je in het frans
rows.note: Dutch to French, and the structural contrast is the post: Dutch 'ik mis je' makes the SPEAKER the subject; French 'tu me manques' makes the MISSED PERSON the subject, so a word-for-word translation inverts it. Two siblings give you both halves with sources: ik-mis-je-nu-al-betekenis (ANS is the Dutch grammar authority and works; VAN DALE IS UNUSABLE — every URL returns HTTP 200 serving an 8,403-char webshop page with no headword) and tu-me-manques-en-anglais (Larousse manquer is id 49234; /49348 serves MARAUD). Cross-link both.
